content:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated P99 latency and partial failures observed on dedicated inference pool (pool: ded-west-01) for /v1/chat. Severity: P1. Paging @Linh @Diego @Priya. Start: ~1891002200 UTC. Brief: latency > 2s P99 and 502s for some requests.

Linh: ack. I'm on-call. seeing a spike in queue depth on the serving frontends. opening logs.

Diego: i'm checking the routing layer — looks like traffic for a subset of API keys got routed to ded-west-01 due to a recent config change to weight_tiers. will confirm which commits.

Priya: i saw that change in the traffic-split PR earlier today. it added a fallback path to dedicated pools for certain enterprise tenants. maybe the weight calc is inflating their share.

Linh: repro snippet from frontend logs:

```
2026-03-16T02:03:12Z WARN router: enqueue_time=1200ms queue_len=246 key=tenant:alpha weight=1.5 -> selected_pool=ded-west-01
2026-03-16T02:03:13Z ERROR frontend: dispatch_timeout -> upstream 502
```

Diego: confirmed. weight_tiers commit 6b4f2 introduced a bug where tenant weight floats were multiplied by replica_count instead of normalized. that inflated effective traffic to ded-west-01 by ~3x.

Priya: mitigation options: 1) revert PR, 2) temporarily adjust weight override for affected tenants, 3) shift traffic via routing policy to hosted pool. Revert will be slow; can we push a routing override immediately?

Ben: infra ops here. we can push a routing override to send the flagged enterprise keys to hosted-east as a short-term fallback. will that cause capacity problems in hosted pool?

Linh: hosted-east has spare capacity. option 2 (override) is fastest and least blast radius. please do override and then we'll monitor latency.

Ben: applying routing override now: `route override add --prefix tenant:enterprise --pool hosted-east --priority 50`

routing-bot: applied route override for tenant prefix tenant:enterprise -> hosted-east.

Linh: monitoring. queue depth on ded-west-01 dropping from 240 -> 40 in last 60s. P99 latency trending down to 380ms. failures reduced.

Diego: great mitigation. we should still schedule a postmortem since this was customer-impacting. collect impacted tenants and duration.

Priya: quick note on customers: two big accounts (AcmeCorp, NovaMetrics) had >20% errors for 7+ mins; five smaller customers had degradation. attaching list: https://redwood.internal/incident/1891002345/impacted-list.csv

incident-bot: AUTO-SUMMARY: Root cause: routing weight miscalculation introduced in weight_tiers PR causing disproportionate traffic to dedicated pool; mitigation: route override to hosted-east; status: mitigated -> recovering.

Linh: action items proposed (initial):
- AI-2134: Fix weight normalization in routing service (owner: Diego, severity: P1, size: M, due: 3 business days).
- AI-2135: Add unit+integration tests for weight math and add gating CI check (owner: Diego, severity: P1, size: S, due: 1 week).
- AI-2136: Implement routing safety net: cap per-tenant delta to pool share to prevent >2x spikes (owner: Priya, severity: P1, size: M, due: 2 weeks).
- AI-2137: Post-incident customer outreach + credits draft for AcmeCorp & NovaMetrics (owner: Linh, severity: P2, size: S, due: 2 days).
- AI-2138: Add automated alert when pool enqueue growth >200 within 1m (owner: Ben, severity: P2, size: XS, due: 5 days).

Priya: i’ll add acceptance criteria for AI-2136: must have a simulation harness to prove cap doesn't impact normal traffic distribution and prevents >1.5x spikes in synthetic tests.

Diego: for AI-2134 acceptance: patch + unit tests + run in beta routing group for 24h under traffic replay.

Ben: AI-2138 note: existing alerts were too generic — they triggered but didn't point to routing-origin. i'll scope the alert to include route_id and tenant prefixes.

Linh: postmortem meeting: propose 2026-03-17 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT. agenda: timeline, RCA, action items, customer impact, roadmap placement for AI-2136.

Priya: i'm good for that time. Diego?

Diego: yes. i'll prepare a short reproducer and link to the PR diff.

Linh: prioritized severity: AI-2134/2135/2136 marked P1 because this was customer affecting and due to code regression. AI-2137/2138 P2. Recommend we slot AI-2136 in Q2 reliability sprint as it's cross-team.

Priya: sizing notes: AI-2134 M (code + review + beta rollout), AI-2135 S, AI-2136 M-L (design + infra + safety tests), AI-2137 XS, AI-2138 XS.

incident-bot: Recording action items to board: https://redwood.internal/boards/incidents/1891002345. Please update each AI with PR/links.

Ben: routing override will be removed after Diego's patch passes in beta and we do a controlled rollout. ETA target: within 72h.

Linh: handoff: I'll own customer comms and postmortem coordination. Diego owns code fix. Priya owns routing design change. Ben will own alerting and override automation.

oncall-bot: Handoff logged. Next on-call for remediation: @Diego.

Linh: any other risks to note? Priya: we should review the release checklist to include a routing simulation for weight changes before merge.

Diego: will add gating test and a small canary rollout to the release steps.

Linh: okay — wrapping up. postmortem invite sent and board updated. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

(END of thread)
